2105-7060-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-7060-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-7060-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-8201.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-2113-3249--206.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
728-1303-2113-3249--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

238-5756-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

710-5617-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-5617-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1594-3330-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-3330-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5078-6650-7692.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

4496-5220-6794-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

560-4659-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-4659-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-2638-4231-5621-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-4231-5621-6441.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6128-7299.description:
Cast Damn for its overload cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
6128-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

396-4019-6972.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Vigean Graftmage.
396-4019-6972.description:
Kill Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Vigean Graftmage enters, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Vigean Graftmage triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Vigean Graftmage dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

225-539-2908-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
225-539-2908-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Dream Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
225-539-2908-6071.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.
Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

480-5256-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

585-1399-1606-3664.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

1987-2468-2751-5139.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Relic of Sauron and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2351-5295-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-5295-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

325-2275-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
325-2275-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
325-2275-6282.description:
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Toluz's second ability triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Repeat from step 2 if needed for each remaining trigger.
Discard down to your maximum hand size again, as you are still in your cleanup step.
Repeat.

4094-4365-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4094-4365-5658-6245.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
4094-4365-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1170-3363-3836-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1682-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1682-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1682-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

290-1978-3301.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Woe Strider, adding {C}{C}.
When Woe Strider dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Woe Strider from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Woe Strider enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

277-835-1737-2544-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Filigree Sages.
277-835-1737-2544-5149.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Tanglepool Bridge.
When Tanglepool Bridge enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Tanglepool Bridge token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1636-4242-4331-4659.notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4242-4331-4659.description:
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
The token Su-Chi enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Su-Chi dies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Su-Chi tokens.

225-2404-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
225-2404-5200.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat.
